description.mn: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Together: Эмэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан цэцэгсийн үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: хан боргоцой, улаан үхрийн нүд, хонхон цэцэг, цээнэ цэцэг.
description.en: First Instinct Together Eau de Parfum For Her by Abercrombie & Fitch is a delightful Floral Fruity fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2020, this new scent features top notes of Pineapple and Red Currant, followed by a heart of Lily-of-the-Valley and Peony. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of Musk, Amber, and Sandalwood.
